component.name: ElixirOffice
component.summary: Local documents, spreadsheets, presentations and PDF

description.p: ElixirOffice edits office documents locally with bundled conversion, fonts, spelling and Help. It supports documents, spreadsheets and presentations, and local PDF workflows. AI is optional and requires a separately configured endpoint and network permission.
Desktop beta update. Exact release tag and acceptance are recorded in the accompanying release notes and build information.
